e396d5b460dd6b22.title: Improved visualization and segmentation of the choroid plexus using double inversion recovery MRI
digest: Background: Choroid plexus (CP) volume is an emerging magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) biomarker in various disorders of the central nervous system (CNS).
However, clinical translation is hindered by methodological heterogeneity and inconsistent anatomical coverage.

Methods: The dataset included 93 scans across healthy subjects and individuals with multiple sclerosis (MS), divided into a training set (n = 63), an internal test set (n = 20), and an external test set (n = 10).

results.verbatim: Results: DIR demonstrated the highest CP signal intensity and most consistent tissue contrast among evaluated MRI sequences (p < 0.001).
Compared to public T1w- and FLAIR-based models, DIR-based approaches (nnU-Net and manual) yielded significantly larger CP volumes (p < 0.01).

Axial volume distribution analysis attributed this difference to a distinct bimodal profile in DIR segmentations, more fully capturing the CP inside the temporal horn of the lateral ventricle (p < 0.001 against T1w- and FLAIR-based models).

246f70d365ffb187.title: Maladaptive trained immunity as a hematopoietic stem cell driver of inflammaging
digest: A new study reveals that aging hematopoietic stem cells trigger a form of innate immune memory, known as trained immunity, that fuels the chronic low-grade inflammation that underlies age-related physiological decline.
SIRT3, a mitochondrial deacetylase whose expression wanes with age, emerges as a key molecular brake on this process.

5ed1ec0758016e8d.title: U-Shaped Association Between Left Ventricular Dimension and Mortality in Patients With Heart Failure.
digest: Importance Left ventricular structural assessment is fundamental in heart failure (HF).
Results A total of 273 921 patients (median [IQR] age, 71.0 [62.0-79.0] years; 161 589 male [59.0%]) hospitalized with HF were included in this study.
Both a small LV (adjusted HR [aHR], 1.32; 95% CI, 1.28-1.37; P < .001) and a large LV (aHR, 1.38; 95% CI, 1.35-1.40; P < .001) were independently associated with elevated all-cause mortality.

evidence.quote: U-Shaped Association Between Left Ventricular Dimension and Mortality in Patients With Heart Failure..

b9bbb5be1419b263.title: Rare variant effect estimation and polygenic risk prediction
digest: RareEffect is an accurate and computationally efficient Bayesian method for estimating rare variant effect sizes. These estimates can be leveraged to improve polygenic prediction models, thereby outperforming other methods for rare variant polygenic scoring.
